summary: Barra Grande Airport (MUU) is a small regional airstrip serving the Maraú Peninsula in Bahia, Brazil, providing essential air access to one of the country's most scenic coastal destinations. The facility primarily handles small charter and private flights, connecting this remote beach paradise to major Brazilian cities. It is the main gateway for visitors heading to the laid-back fishing village of Barra Grande and the peninsula's renowned natural attractions.
faqs:
Q: What airlines fly to Barra Grande Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by small charter and private aviation operators. There are no major scheduled commercial carriers, so most visitors either book private charters or fly into larger airports like Ilhéus or Salvador and arrange ground transfers
